secrets.label: Grok Bot gateway token
secrets.description: Bearer token for the local Grok Bot host. Required for chat. Copied from sand-data/gateway.json (alias agent-data/gateway.json) when the env var is unset.

secrets.label: sand-data root
secrets.description: Optional override for the on-disk host state root. Defaults to /home/box/sand-data (alias /home/box/agent-data).

secrets.label: Grok Bot gateway URL
secrets.description: Gateway on the Grok Bot cloud computer (alias SAND_GATEWAY_URL). Default http://127.0.0.1:1340 requires Space on that computer; elsewhere use a private tunnel. Never expose publicly.

secrets.label: Default Grok Bot agent id
secrets.description: Optional shared host conversation for new Space chats: context is shared across those chats. Leave unset for an isolated seat per Space session. Retained seats must be removed on the host when no longer needed.
